# SmallVector&lt;T&gt;

A growable sequence that holds up to 64 bytes of elements without allocating.

```rux
pub struct SmallVector<T> {
    // private fields
}
```

Move-only: it owns its elements.

## Type parameters

| Name | Description      |
| ---- | ---------------- |
| `T`  | the element type |

## Constructors

<h3 id="new"><code>SmallVector</code></h3>

```rux
pub func SmallVector(allocator: Allocator) -> SmallVector<T>
```

An empty vector, holding its first elements inline.

| Name        | Type        | Description                                       |
| ----------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `allocator` | `Allocator` | where the storage comes from once they outgrow it |

**Returns**: the vector

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Collections/Src/SmallVector.rux#L39)
